Hope they don't seem too silly, but as the tournament approaches we have to
be sure of a few things...

If a minion is at zero stealth at the beginning of the minion phase, he has
to hunt ; but can that action be replaced by another action by another
minion that gives him blood (like Leonardo, Mortician's ability) ?

No. First of all, untapped vampires with 0 blood (or who must hunt due to,
say, XTC laced blood) must hunt right away. This is mandatory TM

That's one thing that makes pulled fangs so cool =)
